description.value: BoulderHouse Langford is the largest indoor bouldering facility on Vancouver Island, developed in partnership with the City of Langford to bring climbing to the West Shore. The two-storey building features 150 linear feet of main climbing wall, a dedicated training area, and a 6,000 sq ft kids section called the TreeHouse on the upper floor. Colour-coded bouldering circuits accommodate all skill levels, from first-timers to experienced climbers.
